description: Jan Evertsenstraat 93-129 odd and 96-140 even (1925-26): dark brown brick, per house one shallow white box frame with a dark hood slab round the window beside a brick lisene (the lisenes stand at every other party wall, the boxes flank them), the other windows flat two-light casements under fixed top lights; a glass-block band over the continuous rigid canopy; a tall plain parapet (about 3 m) with a thin coping

parapet.note: the row's crown: 3.0 m of plain brick over the storeys (13.6-16.6 m on 101 and 118); lisenes stop 0.3 m into it

corner-tower.note: raised corner masses on two-front corner pands (94, 66, 91 on the survey's list): a flat-topped brick tower on the corner, no pyramid

raised-end.note: raised stair-tower ends (55, 57, 143, 145, 150, 152, 155): a narrow brick mass 2.5 m over the parapet across the front, one small light per storey of rise

rhythm.bays: 3 axes per house: the boxed light by the lisene, a flat two-light window, a wide window at the far party wall
rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey the same; houses mirror in pairs about the lisene
rhythm.groundFloor: shop under the continuous rigid canopy, a glass-block band over it
rhythm.signage: letters on the glass-block band (not drawn)
rhythm.roofline: tall plain parapet with a thin coping
schemaLimits: the box and its flat neighbour touch on the photo; the kit keeps a pier between axes
signs on the glass-block band are not drawn
the wide window that straddles a party wall on some pairs is drawn inside one house

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-06, ruler crop of 101: canopy fascia 2.85-3.05 m, glass-block band 3.1-4.65 m (1.55 m, 8 rows of 0.2 m), wall 4.65-5.1 m (8 courses), box windows 5.15-6.95, 8.0-9.85, 10.95-12.85 m (pitch 2.93 m; floors at 4.8/7.73/10.66 m give sill 0.10, head 0.72, height 0.62 of the storey), hood slabs about 0.15 m on each box top, lisene 0.4 m wide from 4.7 to 13.6 m, eaves 16.6 m: a 3.0 m parapet over the storeys (55 courses); top light 0.2 of the window

strip.jpg 2024-12-06, ruler crop of 118: the same lines (canopy 3.0-3.2, glass block 3.3-4.6, windows 5.0-6.9 / 8.0-9.85 / 10.9-12.85 m, hood about 13.0 m, eaves 16.6 m); 126 matches (body NCC on the zoom)

palette over the 40 pands of the type (de-baarsjes-palettes.ts): wall #54432e, frames #acab93, coping/cornice band #554b38 (n=40); glass-block rows 3.3-4.5 m on 101 and 103 #4c4d3c-#5a5946 (the 3.3-4.5 m rows over 101 #4f503f; the type-wide median #46432f picks up canopy rows where the band sits lower); hood slabs sampled on 101 (sample.mjs on the strip): #3d3827 on the top hood, #2c2718 and #292412 on the lower two (in their own shadow); the top one is the palette

schemaLimits: 121-125 (085815) is one 37 m mass: a large recipe in this body
notes: Each house's shop gives awning {style: rigid, glassBlocks: {rows: 8}, wallCourses: 8} so the canopy and the band land on the measured lines; palette.glassBlock exports the band as its own measured material.
Place with mirror: true on every other house so the boxes flank the shared lisene (lisenes leftEnd half on both, mirrored).
